unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #10 "A Nano (XNO) settle option so the review payment only lands when the review does — no six-hour refund window for a rejected review" on usebrainchain/review-action, verified OPEN. Argued from its README: pays 1 USDC up front, refund after ~6h dispute window if Jev rejects, fails if refund cannot be sent; XNO makes the send conditional on acceptance, no fronting, no refund window, tighter budget lockup. Carry: github.com/dhyabi2/nano-invoice. URL: https://github.com/usebrainchain/review-action/issues/10
